## vfrey skills {{VERSION}}

The vfrey skill and {{STYLES}} video styles, as zips you can unzip into your agent's skills folder.

- vfrey-complete.zip: the vfrey skill and every style (start here)
- vfrey-styles-all.zip: every style, without the vfrey skill
- vfrey-bundle-illustrated.zip, vfrey-bundle-3d.zip, vfrey-bundle-data.zip, vfrey-bundle-retro.zip: themed groups of styles
- vfrey-style-<name>.zip: one style

What changed: (fill in before publishing)
